besluite.fout: 'vertel stories aan mekaar' is stiffer than the natural double-object form the block's own heading uses, and it puts 'mekaar' right before 'hulle', so the pronoun could be read as the people rather than the stories.
besluite.rede: The natural Afrikaans form keeps the same meaning, matches the heading, and leaves 'stories' as the only thing 'hulle' can point to.
